description: DuraCeramic is significantly warmer than ceramic and other natural stones. Ceramic tile will feel colder. However, if you have in-floor heat then it would be warmer but that also adds to the cost. With DuraCeramic you will notice less heat loss, naturally, thus your heat stays with you when and where you need it. 17 sq.ft per box and sold by the full boxes only.
